pages.name: Bisyk
pages.text: A small thief. Charming to look at, but with a devil of a temper.

pages.title: Theft
pages.text: Nimble paws rummage through your pockets. Sometimes after a hit the bisyk pulls an item from your inventory.$(br2)$(#7952A6)Do not delay:$() recover the item as soon as you can. Especially if a $(l:forest/skarbnyk)Skarbnyk$(/l) is near: then the item may vanish another way.
